answer: A concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a scarce resource. Each identity must burn a small amount of compute or stake funds that rust away if idle, like a ferrous tool left in the rain. A fresh identity begins as a lone island with no reputation: it must complete real, verifiable jobs before others trust it. Random liveness checks take the pulse of the network, revoking standing from accounts that act only in lockstep bursts, so a thousand fake copies cost real effort and still earn no trust.
